fusions.name: Motionless Snatch
fusions.desc: Waits, then snatches: deals 22 damage, adding 1.4 times the remaining damage of your afflictions on the target. Your first strike at an unwounded enemy has 50% more critical chance. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Dropped Fingertip
fusions.desc: Sheds a fingertip that regrows at once and flicks it, spending 5% of your maximum health to deal 8 damage to the first enemy it meets.

fusions.name: Basking Palms
fusions.desc: You turn your palms to the warmth and regain 4 health a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Sun-Warmed Knuckles
fusions.desc: During the day, you deal 10% more damage.
